kind: local pre-deploy bench: txid display recent runtimes built by the controller and shipped with each candidate, against local builds on the worker
deployment: none; no production host was contacted

source.run2: 5525b839 (shipped files written without fsync; worker shipped/self_check_ms copied into the cycle record)
source.note: built from pre-rebase commits 77bfa446 (run 2) and 72bc5311 (run 1); rebasing onto docs-only main changed no source file, so these main commits hold the same source
source.run1: 6b8c5c91 (shipped files fsynced; worker reply fields not copied into cycles[].workers)

build: cargo build --locked --profile release-fast -p transparent-shard-server --bin transparent-txid-server -p transparent-filter-server --bin txid-display-controller; RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=x86-64-v3 -C target-feature=+pclmulqdq; hashes in raw/run*/binaries.sha256
command: harness/bench.sh BIN_DIR WORK_DIR raw/runN; python3 harness/analyze.py raw/runN > summary.json
host: roman-dev-2: DO-Premium-Intel, 8 vCPU (AVX2, no AVX-512), 31 GiB, Linux 6.8.0-134-generic; shared with other agents' builds

cpu_limits.worker: taskset -c 6,7, TRANSPARENT_BUILD_THREADS=2, --build-slots 1 (recent-01 zz-latency.conf CPUQuota=200%, two build threads)

worker_flags: --role recent-replica --cache-bytes 536870912 --build-slots 1 --query-slots 2 --retain-revisions 1; no runtime disk cache; no queries
rsync: rsync -a --delete --numeric-ids --stats [--exclude=*.runtime] --link-dest=<previous> next/ dest/.tmp-next/; local disk; 5 repeats each; sync -f included
limits: rsync measured on local disk, not over SSH on the private network
worker CPU on a faster idle CPU than recent-01
two runs on a shared host
